description: Five checkability probes for a claim sentence extracted from a corporate climate/sustainability pledge or report. Each probe asks whether one auditable element is present in the sentence text; none asks whether the claim is true or sincere.

probes.citation: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard (WRI/WBCSD, rev. ed.) ch.9 — a reduction target must be expressed as a quantified amount, not a qualitative direction.
Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) Corporate Net-Zero Standard v1.2 §4.2 — near-term and long-term targets must specify a target year.
GHG Protocol Corporate Standard (WRI/WBCSD, rev. ed.) ch.5 — a base year and base-year emissions must be established and disclosed for any reduction target to be verifiable.
TCFD Recommendations (Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures, 2017) — disclosures should name the accounting/reporting standard or scope framework used to measure the claim.
ISSB IFRS S2 (Climate-related Disclosures, 2023) §6 — governance disclosures require identifying the body or role accountable for climate-related targets.

bands.label: Unverifiable
bands.description: Aspirational language with no auditable component; a reader has nothing to check.

bands.label: Weak
bands.description: One auditable element present; the rest of the claim cannot be checked without contacting the company.

bands.label: Partial
bands.description: About half the auditable elements present; enough to start checking, not enough to finish.

bands.label: Mostly Checkable
bands.description: Nearly every auditable element present; one gap remains.

bands.label: Fully Checkable
bands.description: All five auditable elements present; the claim can be independently verified against public data.
